content: भूत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [भू-क्त] .²1 Become, being, existing. .²2 Produced, formed. .²3 Actually being, really happened, true; भूताश्चार्था विरुद्धपन्ति देशकालविरोधिताः <ls>Rām. 5. 30. 37</ls>. .²4 Right, proper, fit; अभूतेनापवादेन कीर्तिं निपतितामिव <ls>Rām. 5. 15. 34</ls>; भूतार्थव्याहृतिः सा हि न स्तुतिः परमेष्ठिनः <ls>R. 10. 33</ls>. .²5 Past, gone. .²6 Obtained. .²7 Mixed or joined with. .²8 Being like, similar, (see भू); मग्नां द्विषच्छद्मनि पङ्कभूते <ls>Ki. 3. 39</ls>. .{@-तः@} .²1 A son, child. .²2 An epithet of Śiva. .²3 The fourteenth day of the dark half of a lunar month (also भूता). .²4 A great devotee. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a priest of the gods. .²6 The dark fortnight of a month (कृष्णपक्ष). .²7 see भूतगण. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Any being (human, divine or even inanimate); इत्थं रतेः किमपि भूतमदृश्यरूपं मन्दीचकार मरणव्यवसायबुद्धिम् <ls>Ku. 4. 45</ls>; <ls>Pt. 2. 87</ls>. .²2 A living being, an animal, a creature; क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते <ls>Bg. 15. 16</ls>; भूतेषु किं च करुणां बहुलीकरोति <ls>Bv. 1. 122</ls>; <ls>U. 4. 6</ls>. .²3 A spirit, ghost, an imp, a devil ({%m.%} also in these senses); ततो रक्षां महातेजः कुरु भूतविनाशिनीम् <ls>Rām. 7. 66. 3</ls>. .²4 An element; (they are five, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} पृथ्वी, अप्, तेजस्, वायु, and आकाश); तं वेधा विदधे नूनं महाभूतसमाधिना <ls>R. 1. 29</ls>. .²5 An actual occurrence, a fact, a matter of fact. .²6 The past, past time. .²7 The world. .²8 Well-being, welfare. .²9 A symbolical expression for the number ‘five’. .²10 Fitness, propriety.
